title: Azure SQL Database: Vectors, Row-Level Security & Text-to-SQL
description: Integrate Azure SQL Database with AI workflows: native vector functions, Row-Level Security (RLS), Dynamic Data Masking, and safe Text-to-SQL generation.

data.text: The Relational Backbone of Enterprise AI

While vector databases power semantic retrieval, the vast majority of enterprise operational data—financial ledgers, ERP transactions, customer records, and inventory catalogs—resides in relational databases like Azure SQL Database and SQL Server. Integrating AI with Azure SQL requires combining relational ACID constraints with native vector search, Row-Level Security (RLS) to enforce data boundaries, and safe Text-to-SQL generation patterns.
Native Vector Support in Azure SQL Database

Azure SQL Database introduces native vector functions, allowing developers to store vector embeddings in standard VARBINARY or JSON columns and calculate similarity directly inside T-SQL queries using VECTOR_DISTANCE.

data.text: Allowing an LLM to generate SQL queries directly against a production database without guardrails is a severe security risk (SQL injection, accidental drops, data leaks). Safe enterprise Text-to-SQL follows a 4-tier defense architecture:

data.title: Text-to-SQL Security Guardrails
items: Read-Only Service Account: Connect using a database user with strict SELECT-only permissions. Deny all INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, and DDL permissions.
AST Query Sanitization: Parse the LLM's generated SQL with TSqlParser from Microsoft.SqlServer.DacFx; reject any query containing semicolons, unions, or unauthorized system tables.
Row-Level Security (RLS): Enforce database-level session contexts (sp_set_session_context) so the query can only see rows belonging to the caller's TenantId.
Dynamic Data Masking (DDM): Mask sensitive customer columns (credit cards, emails) at the database layer so even SELECT queries return masked values to the model.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Azure SQL Database natively supports vector operations alongside relational tables using VECTOR_DISTANCE
Combine relational filters (WHERE Category = ...) with vector similarity in a single ACID transaction
Never execute raw LLM-generated SQL without a read-only role, AST parser validation, and statement timeouts
Enforce Row-Level Security (RLS) to guarantee multi-tenant isolation at the engine level
Leverage Dynamic Data Masking to protect PII from being ingested into AI context windows
data.takeaway: Azure SQL unites relational transactional data with vector search. With strict read-only roles, AST validation, and Row-Level Security, .NET teams can build secure, enterprise-grade Text-to-SQL solutions.
